mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts central bank policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the average return in triggered months is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and weak consumer credit demand (RSAFS < 500000) signals an impending economic stimulus, causing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through a joint effect of monetary ease and demand weakness.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS < 2.5% AND RSAFS < 500000) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 108.0) signals manufacturing slowdown, triggering positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention to prevent recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when the regime is late-cycle expansion and INDPRO < 108.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past 6 months indicates strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate earnings growth is supported.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1200.0 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic growth concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 150000 thousand) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 109.0) signals an overheating economy with supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through a joint effect of wage pressures and manufacturing bottlenecks.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 150000 AND INDPRO < 109.0) fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a positive coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as higher borrowing costs dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when the regime is monetary tightening cycle and FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
